title: Cheap South Florida Social Picks This Weekend
igCaption:
Weekend picks: a $28 train deal, Wynwood pizza, a closed Fort Lauderdale nightclub, and a GTA VI festival in Miami.

Sources: Secret Miami, Miami New Times, CBS News, WPEC, Sun Sentinel

#MiamiWeekend #SouthFlorida #FortLauderdale #Wynwood

scenes.text: Weekend picks: the $28 train deal and one closed club note.
Amtrak has Miami to Orlando and Miami to Tampa fares as low as $28 each way. You have to book by November 12 for travel from December 1 through March 14.
scenes.caption: Amtrak has Miami to Orlando and Miami to Tampa fares as low as $28 each way. You have to book by Nov. 12 for travel from Dec. 1 through Mar. 14.

scenes.text: For a food stop, Francesco Martucci is at 10 NE 27th St. in Wynwood. Food & Wine named it the best pizzeria in Florida, and 50 Top Pizza ranked it No. 27 in the world for 2026.

scenes.text: In downtown Fort Lauderdale, Backyard had an overnight fire. Reports said officials declared it a total loss. If you were there, NEAR shows who else was at Backyard that night.

scenes.text: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival lands at Mana Wynwood on Saturday, November 21. The lineup includes Travis Scott, Don Toliver, Kodak Black, Sofaygo, Cardi B, Metro Boomin, Tainy, Rauw Alejandro & Friends, Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso, and Suero.
